oneOf.description: The given beta is unlevered; return the levered beta.
The given beta is levered; return the unlevered beta.

BetaFormula.description: Formula linking levered and unlevered beta.

oneOf.description:
Hamada: β_L = β_U + (β_U − β_D)(1 − t) D/E (debt at a fixed amount, tax shield at the
cost of debt).
Harris-Pringle: β_L = β_U + (β_U − β_D) D/E (debt rebalanced to a target ratio).

beta.description: Beta to convert (unlevered for `relever`, levered for `unlever`), dimensionless.

debt_beta.description: Beta of debt, dimensionless. Default: 0 (risk-free debt).

debt_to_equity.description: Debt-to-equity ratio D/E, decimal (0.5 = debt equal to half of equity), not negative.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate of the tax shield, decimal fraction from 0 to below 1.
